audit_scope: Faculty Portal Rebuild & Attendance Synchronization Audit (Phases 1-12)

defect_inventory_resolution.title: Faculty marked attendance not reflected in Student Subject Breakdown
defect_inventory_resolution.root_cause: 1. Mobile Client: StudentService.fetchAttendanceReport() parsed date_wise from API response but discarded response['subjects']. 2. StudentAttendanceReportScreen only fetched data if dateWise was empty. 3. Backend Policy Engine: calculate_all_subjects_attendance filtered subjects strictly by student.class_id, omitting electives and substitute faculty assignments.
defect_inventory_resolution.resolution: Updated StudentService to populate _subjects and recalculate summary from API response; updated StudentAttendanceReportScreen to refresh on initState; updated AttendancePolicyEngine to query both assigned subjects and subjects with recorded attendance.

defect_inventory_resolution.title: 24-hour military timestamps displayed on faculty schedule and attendance screens
defect_inventory_resolution.root_cause: Faculty dashboard and attendance screens rendered raw 24-hour HH:MM strings without 12-hour AM/PM formatting.
defect_inventory_resolution.resolution: Created TimezoneUtils.format24hTo12h() in Flutter and format_time_12h() in timetable_engine.py. Applied 12-hour AM/PM formatting across Faculty Dashboard, Active Slot, Attendance Screen, and Class Advisor Screen.

defect_inventory_resolution.title: Naive UTC weekday calculation mismatch in Asia/Kolkata timezone
defect_inventory_resolution.root_cause: FacultyDashboardScreen called DateTime.now().weekday without timezone normalization, causing wrong day selection between 00:00 and 05:30 IST.
defect_inventory_resolution.resolution: Implemented TimezoneUtils.istWeekdayName() and integrated with faculty dashboard weekday selector.

defect_inventory_resolution.title: Excessive specular glare and over-bright borders in dark theme
defect_inventory_resolution.root_cause: AppColors.dark defined overly bright card borders (0x4D7E7594) and specular glass gradients (0.35 opacity white shine).
defect_inventory_resolution.resolution: Softened dark borders to 0x1F7E7594, reduced specular glare from 0.35 to 0.12, added darkSpecularGradient. Light theme left 100% untouched.

defect_inventory_resolution.title: Backend attendance concurrency exception logger NameError
defect_inventory_resolution.root_cause: app/engines/attendance_engine.py referenced logger.warning() in start_class_session() concurrency exception handler without defining logger module variable.
defect_inventory_resolution.resolution: Added authoritative logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) to attendance_engine.py.

defect_inventory_resolution.title: start_class_session naive datetime usage
defect_inventory_resolution.root_cause: start_class_session() called datetime.now() instead of get_ist_now().
defect_inventory_resolution.resolution: Replaced naive datetime.now() with get_ist_now() in attendance_engine.py.

defect_inventory_resolution.title: Faculty Dashboard and Timetable App Bar Title Ellipsis Truncation
defect_inventory_resolution.root_cause: Dense header action icon row caused 'Faculty Dashboard' to truncate as 'Faculty D...' and 'Faculty Timetable' as 'Faculty Timeta...'.
defect_inventory_resolution.resolution: Applied compact VisualDensity and adjusted action button margins and title text sizing (16sp) ensuring full title visibility without ellipsis.

defect_inventory_resolution.title: fac04 Class Advisor and Multi-Faculty Assignment Access
defect_inventory_resolution.root_cause: Audit of database revealed fac04 is Faculty ID 6 (Shankar). Is not class advisor for any class, but is authorized substitute faculty for Class 4 assignments (ACE-I, TWM).
defect_inventory_resolution.resolution: Verified that fac04 can mark attendance for Class 4 assignments as authorized substitute, while Class Advisor portal correctly shows 'Not Assigned as Class Advisor' without crashing or showing unauthorized classes.

tests.name: test_format_time_12h
tests.description: Verifies 12-hour AM/PM formatting utility converts 24h institutional schedule times accurately.

tests.name: test_attendance_sync_and_subject_wise_update
tests.description: Verifies end-to-end synchronization: faculty creates session, marks attendance -> DB persists -> AttendancePolicyEngine calculates subject attendance -> Student API returns updated subject count and percentage -> Admin API matches.
